summary: The stored positive rests on one crossover trial in 9 men (21793317). Two other endurance trials found nothing (8778554, 11099371). The placebo-controlled fatigue trial (14971626) did not show overall efficacy, and a 144-person stress trial (23740477) found the effect of adding ES negligible. Small positives are transient (15207399), surrogate (38525193) or acute edema (27333960). 16 of 27 labels print a powder row; only the edema trial names powder.
